companies.name: ニューウェル・ブランズ

relations.text: Newellが10-Kで、Graingerを上位10顧客の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Newell lists Grainger among its top-ten customers

source.label: Newell Brands 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company's top-ten customers in 2025 included (in alphabetical order): Amazon.com Inc., Costco Wholesale Corporation, Grainger Inc., Office Depot Inc., Staples Inc., Target Corporation, The Home Depot Inc., The Kroger Co., Uline Inc. and Walmart Inc. and subsidiaries.

relations.text: 1847 Holdingsが10-Kで、Graingerを顧客の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: 1847 Holdings names Grainger among its customers

source.label: 1847 Holdings 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have a diverse customer base, including Amazon, AutoZone, Advance Auto Parts, CarQuest, Aries, das, Grainger, and FleetFarm.

source.quote: Our significant suppliers in the Waste Heat Recovery business include Powerhouse, Concise Instrument, and Grainger.

source.quote: The Endless Assortment segment includes the Company's Zoro Tools, Inc. (Zoro) and MonotaRO Co., Ltd. (MonotaRO) online channels which operate predominately in the U.S. and Japan, respectively.

companies.name: ジェニュイン・パーツ

relations.text: Genuine Partsが10-Kで、産業部品流通の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Genuine Parts names Grainger a competitor in industrial distribution

source.label: Genuine Parts 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In industrial distribution, our main competitor is Applied Industrial Technologies, Inc., but we also compete against Fastenal Company, and W.W. Grainger, Inc, among many other smaller, regional competitors.

companies.name: グローバル・インダストリアル

relations.text: Global Industrialが10-Kで、大手MRO卸の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Global Industrial names Grainger among large MRO distributor competitors

source.label: Global Industrial 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We face competition from large diversified MRO distributors such as Uline Inc, Grainger Inc., MSC Industrial Direct Inc., Fastenal Inc., and other large retailers, including Amazon.
